info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Advanced Voice Services Management API enables users to modify channel-specific configurations within banking systems. This operation allows businesses to enhance their voice service delivery by making targeted updates based on unique parameters. Typical consumers of this API include developers working on banking applications that require real-time adjustments to voice services. Use cases involve optimizing service settings to improve customer interactions and operational efficiency.

patch.summary: Update Advanced Voice Services Management for a specific channel.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the advanced voice services management settings for the resource identified by RES-100045 within a specific channel. Use this operation to change configurations, update settings, or make adjustments required for the optimal performance of voice services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the advanced voice services settings for a specific channel, identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON object must adhere to the defined schema, containing all necessary attributes to ensure a successful update.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the resource has been updated.
